description: The object list (0x80) and metadata record (0x85) as ISO-TP transfers on the radar bus, the clock the records follow, and whether the uncertainty codes behave like sigma or variance. Three cars, 2,370 segments; drives anonymised.

transfers.second_car_list_outages: radar and camera kept every other frame at full rate; only the flow control stopped

uncertainty_form.model: rms^2 = floor_band^2 + (k code)^2 (sigma) vs floor_band^2 + k code (variance), 5 m bands, same parameter count, leave-one-band-out
uncertainty_form.parked: standstill codes span 1-9 only: sigma and variance not separable; 240|7 codes 1-5 do not grade the speed noise (0.05-0.07 m/s)
